bearingSource: OSM way 1366197034 long axis 82.8°; +X = east, the two short wings of the U project north (−Z); neo-Gothic tower on the west side at −X (szamos.ro; photos 02, 04, 07)
approximations: Only the south and west fronts are photographed: courtyard (north) elevations, window rhythm there and the rear roofs are assumed. The 14.5 m deep middle range is modelled as a tiled front tract plus a lower rear tract under a low-pitch natural-zinc standing-seam roof — inferred from photo 05 (zinc roof being laid against a tiled eave), its true position is not documented. Heights estimated (west pavilion eave 7.3 m, middle range 5.3 m, east pavilion 5.6 m, spire needle ≈ 20.8 m); the tower (4 × 4 m, projecting 2.6 m) and the octagonal SW corner bay lie outside the coarse OSM outline; stepped-gable outlines, corbel frieze, drip-mould hoods and spire lucarnes simplified; east pavilion north end assumed hipped. Observed materials: main roofs ceramic beaver-tail tiles (bright orange on the pavilions, darker reused tiles on the middle range); natural titanium-zinc on the spire, lucarnes, broaches, the ogee dome of the corner bay, flashings, half-round gutters, downpipes and chimney caps. Photo 01 is a COLOR METAL material card naming elZinc natural titanium-zinc strip (0.6 × 670 mm), which matches the photographed zinc, but the register entry is still empty.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile fațadelor de sud și de vest: conac în formă de U cu turn neogotic și flișă, bovindou octogonal de colț cu cupolă în acoladă și două frontoane în trepte; flișa, cupola, șorțurile, jgheaburile și burlanele din titan-zinc natural, acoperișurile principale din țiglă ceramică. Latura dinspre curte nu a fost fotografiată și este simplificată, acoperișul jos din zinc al traveei din spate este dedus dintr-o fotografie de șantier, iar înălțimile sunt estimate.
note.hu: A déli és nyugati homlokzatról készült referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett: U alaprajzú kúria neogótikus toronnyal és toronysisakkal, nyolcszögű sarokerkély hagymaíves kupolával és két lépcsős oromzattal; a toronysisak, a kupola, a szegélyek, az ereszcsatornák és lefolyók natúr titáncinkből, a fő tetők kerámia hódfarkú cseréppel fedettek. Az udvari oldalt nem fényképezték, ezért egyszerűsített; a hátsó traktus alacsony cinktetejét egy építési fotó alapján feltételeztük, a magasságok becsültek.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from the photographs of the south and west fronts: U-shaped manor with a neo-Gothic tower and spire, an octagonal corner bay with an ogee dome and two stepped gables; spire, dome, flashings, gutters and downpipes in natural titanium-zinc, main roofs in ceramic tiles. The courtyard side was not photographed and is simplified, the low zinc roof of the rear tract is inferred from a construction photo, and heights are estimated.
